description:
Convert the Maven-based Java project 'data-utils' at ~/IdeaProjects/data-utils to use Gradle as its build system.

The project currently uses Maven (pom.xml) with these dependencies:
- junit:junit:4.13.2 (test scope)
- org.slf4j:slf4j-api:2.0.9
- com.google.guava:guava:32.1.3-jre
- com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.16.0
- org.apache.commons:commons-lang3:3.14.0

The project uses Java 17 source/target compatibility and has a main class at com.datautils.App.

You must:
1. Create a settings.gradle file with the project name 'data-utils'
2. Create a build.gradle file that:
   - Applies the 'java' plugin
   - Sets sourceCompatibility and targetCompatibility to Java 17
   - Uses mavenCentral() as repository
   - Declares all dependencies with correct scopes (implementation for runtime deps, testImplementation for test deps)
   - Configures the jar manifest Main-Class to 'com.datautils.App'
3. Ensure 'gradle build' succeeds (compiles all sources, runs all tests, produces a JAR)

The build.gradle and settings.gradle files must be at ~/IdeaProjects/data-utils/
